name: Studio product, slow arc
summary: A small, slow arc around your product on a clean backdrop.
outcome: A small, slow arc around your product on a clean backdrop, with a soft light sweep.
photoGuidance: A photo of the product on a plain background.
limitations: The camera only moves a little, because any side of the product that isn't in your photo has to be imagined by the model.
Text and logos in your photo may change in the video. Check the result before you post it.

inputs.label: Details to keep as they are
inputs.help: Optional. For example, the colour of your cups or the shape of a sign.

inputs.label: Anything to leave out
inputs.help: Optional. For example, no smoke or no people.

prompt.preserve: Keep everything in the photo recognisable: the same objects, shapes, colours and proportions. Keep any printed text, labels and logos as they are.
prompt.avoid: Do not add people, hands, text, captions, logos or new objects. No sudden cuts, no camera shake, no warping or melting of surfaces.
prompt.subject: The photo shows {subject} on a plain backdrop.
prompt.composition: The product stays centred and whole.
prompt.environment: The backdrop stays plain, as in the photo.
prompt.camera: The camera makes a very small, slow arc around the product.
prompt.lighting: A soft light sweeps slowly across the product.
